archived_pin_mappings.reason: Unexecuted stale descriptor rejected before stage; earlier test bytes archived, current test separately retained. No source or pin rewritten.

historical_preparations: Superseded unexecuted manifests/prepared plans retained byte-exact. Their historical source claims are not substituted for executed final pins.
raw_json_path_rule: Absolute original paths inside preserved raw JSON are provenance only. Consumers fetch only explicit relative index/manifest URLs.
